name: lidocaine
notes: Prototypical amide LA; intermediate potency/duration. Systemic toxicity tracks FREE drug; binding is moderate (~65%). Toxicity-threshold ranges + the double-uncertainty view are v0.6 LA1; the cardiotoxicity comparison is LA2. Concentrations in ug/mL.

protein_binding.note: ~65% bound, principally to α1-acid glycoprotein (an acute-phase protein), not chiefly albumin — so the v0.5 hypoalbuminemia free-fraction caveat does NOT apply to LAs; LA-specific free-fraction handling is v0.6 LA1/LA3.

cardiotoxicity_class.mechanism: Achiral, lower-potency, lower-lipophilicity amide; cardiovascular depression occurs well above the CNS-toxicity range. The wide CNS-to-CVS margin (CNS symptoms and seizures precede cardiovascular toxicity) is the opposite of bupivacaine's narrow one.
cardiotoxicity_class.note: The prototypical 'wide-margin' amide — used here as the wide-margin anchor of the v0.6 LA2 agent-choice comparison.
